errors.evidence: The figure is a three-level sunburst/pie chart with many more than 13 slices, not a single 13-slice pie.

errors.text_span: representing categories such as “TIALD”, “Not Abusive”, “Religious”, “Political”, “Abusive”, “Sexist”, “Racist”, “Negative”, “Positive”, “Neutral”, “Mixed”, and “Other”
errors.evidence: TiALD is the center label, not a slice/category. 'Racist' is not a label in the figure; the visible category is 'Racial'. The chart is hierarchical, so these labels do not all represent one flat set of slices.

errors.text_span: The slices vary in color, including shades of blue, green, yellow, orange, and pink.
errors.evidence: The chart primarily uses two color families: teal/blue for Abusive and yellow/gold for Not Abusive. Pink is not present, and the description overstates the palette.

errors.text_span: “TIALD” occupies roughly 12% of the chart, “Not Abusive” around 10%, “Religious” about 9%, “Political” around 7%, “Abusive” approximately 7%, “Sexist” about 6%, “Racist” approximately 5%, “Negative” accounts for around 18%, “Positive” approximately 8%, “Neutral” around 8%, “Mixed” covers approximately 12%, and “Other” is approximately 7%.
errors.evidence: These percentages are not shown in the figure and several are inconsistent with the visual proportions. TiALD is a center label and does not occupy 12% of the chart.

errors.text_span: A legend is present in the upper-right corner, identifying each category with a corresponding color
errors.evidence: The figure has no legend; labels are placed directly on the segments.
The description does not clearly state the chart shows task-wise class distributions centered on TiALD, as indicated by the title/caption and image.
The description misses the hierarchical three-ring sunburst structure and the fact that labels are directly embedded in the slices with a hollow center labeled TiALD.

errors.text_span: The segments appear to be ordered in a clockwise direction, roughly based on the visual impression of descending segment size.
errors.evidence: The chart is not arranged in descending order, and the figure does not indicate a size-based ordering of segments.
